title: Sub-agents
summary: The sub-agents of a scope as one card each, running first, readable without opening any: the goal, what it does now, its last steps, its counts, its result or its error.
purpose: SubagentActivityList (pi-chat-subagent) over a plain array of delegate details with the app's own words (task, now, steps, counts, result). Nothing is fetched; a card opens the child conversation. Fictional data, no model, no network.

try.label: Read the three sub-agents without opening one
Open the child conversation of one

notes: The running card comes first and shows its goal, one live line, its last steps and counts; the finished one its result; the failed one its error. Every line is one line (truncated), the result at most three. French by labels (lang=fr); the app's own sentences are not translated by the kit.

steps.expect: The running one is first with its goal and its live line; the result and the error show without a tap.

steps.say: Tap the conversation of the first card
steps.expect: The host is asked to open that child conversation.
